scope: Offline Italian lessons with German and English meanings.

'portone che dà sulla strada principale' (10 w); follow-up now names the main door explicitly and the awning reply (10 w) adapts the meeting point; cloze tenda/verde foils all impossible by gender/number; Lei both ways ('mi aspetta' / 'La aspetto').

'Il cortile che vedo dalla mia finestra ha un fico…' (14 w); merged first chip removes the 'ha un fico che vedo' reordering; term 'il cancello pedonale' matches turn 4 'quello pedonale'; cloze 'due cancelli' rejects all three singular foils.

First dove episode: 'sul pianerottolo dove comincia la seconda rampa' (9 w); 'illumina' is now a choice row; provisional lamp solution accepted (9 w); terms, recall 'comincia' and speak tokens all from turn 1.

'del lavello dove sciacquo i piatti, ma solo quando apro l'acqua calda' (15 w) gives place and time per beat; form gap 'riguarda' carries subject 'il problema'; comma-final chip is allowed; kitchen vs bathroom distinction clear.

'nel punto in cui la piastra tocca il legno' (16 w, at limit); merged noun-phrase chip removes 'nel punto della porta' reorder; form gap 'gira' has subject 'una vite'; 'a vuoto' fixed expression; learner and technician agree to start with the screws (12 w).
Object-relative che ho visto identifies the shelf; the beech substitute retains the sixty-centimetre constraint. No width clue in the scene. The German art caption now calls the shopper a customer.

Deve is now a visible four-way choice with exactly one grammatical completion; the proposed street-side terrace is distinguished by the courtyard requirement. The revised German dialogue and model show a subject-relative with die … hat; interessa, balcone and cortile occur as independent words in the Italian reply.

The revised Italian explicitly puts the crowd davanti al portone; English and German now likewise locate the crowd before the main door, motivating the nearby awning. La aspetto is formal and both choice rows remain unambiguous.

The rebuilt first chip binds the courtyard to che vedo dalla mia finestra. Four chips reconstruct the original turn and the pedestrian-gate clarification still works. The revised term il cancello pedonale, das Fußgängertor and the pedestrian gate now match the access being clarified.

Illumina is now a visible four-way agreement choice. The hypothetical reading of the proposed lamp can no longer cause a false typing failure. Pianerottolo, seconda and rampa are substantive cues for the switch location and all three are distinct whole words in the model.
The leaking kitchen tap, hot-water trigger and dry bathroom form a coherent problem. Dove and temporal quando have different functions.
The velvet jacket at the umbrella counter leads to a zip/low-collar distinction; the choices are fixed by masculine singular and plural agreement.
Con cui first appears at L8, with a portrait pencil as transfer. Mother’s initials distinguish the case without being shown by the scene.
A cui matches affidare a; the rear workshop and the estimate answer two different needs. Both choice blanks require infinitives. The revised German art caption correctly calls the visitor a customer.

In cui locates the plate against the wood; the spinning screw gives a reason to start there. The hiking-trail example supplies a new location. The revised chips bind the entire door-handle noun phrase and correctly gloss balla and nel punto.

Object-relative che vedo, main-clause ha, and a second access gate implement the courtyard beat; there is another plausible chip order.
Dove introduces a landing as its antecedent and the shuttle-stop example transfers it. Illumination is a plausible conditional as well as a present in this reply.

findings.issue: After the agent offers a street-facing terrace, both «ma deve affacciarsi sul cortile» and the natural, polite «ma dovrebbe affacciarsi sul cortile» fit. The typed cue specifies dovere and the subject, but gives no tense/mood; the conditional was taught in P3.
findings.recommendation: Use a choice row for deve, retain the four existing options, and remove the form cue, or write a cue that uniquely selects the present indicative.

findings.issue: The electrician has offered to leave a lamp and has not placed it yet. «Va bene, la lampada illuminerebbe almeno i primi gradini» is a natural response to that offer and fits the displayed infinitive/subject cue. Only illumina is credited.
findings.recommendation: Use choice for this blank with the current agreement options, or specify present indicative without exposing the conjugated form.

findings.issue: «L’ingresso laterale è chiuso, quindi tutti aspettano già lì davanti» leaves lì most immediately pointing at the side entrance just described as closed. The crowd is meant to be at the previously agreed main door, motivating another meeting point.
findings.recommendation: Name the main door explicitly, e.g. «Oggi l’ingresso laterale è chiuso e davanti al portone principale c’è già tanta gente.» Sync EN/DE.

findings.issue: The existing four chips can also form «Il cortile ha un fico che vedo dalla mia finestra in mezzo al prato.» This gives the fig tree, which is visible from the window, as the relative antecedent and largely preserves the pictured situation.
findings.recommendation: To pin the intended courtyard antecedent, bind it to che vedo dalla mia finestra, then split the rest into ha / un fico / in mezzo al prato., with contextual glosses.

findings.issue: The illustration calls a furniture-shop customer «ein Gast» while the English and scene depict a retail customer. The same mismatch recurs in L9 (electronics shop).
findings.recommendation: Use Kunde/Kundin or a neutral retail description in both German placeholders.

lessonsRead.observation: Object relative che ho visto (14/11 words), beech substitute keeps the sixty-centimetre limit; massima/resta blanks unique; chips build uniquely; only the German placeholder calls the customer 'Gast'.

Subject relative che ha with the courtyard requirement retained against the street terrace (10/10 words); typed 'deve' is not pinned against 'dovrebbe'; DE gloss of turn 1 uses 'deren' instead of modelling 'die … hat'.

La aspetto davanti al portone che dà sulla strada principale (10/10 words) with che dà su transfer; two choice rows unambiguous; the caretaker's 'lì davanti' points at the closed side entrance rather than the crowded main door.

Che vedo + main-clause ha + pedestrian-gate clarification (14/9 words); current four chips also yield the grammatical 'Il cortile ha un fico che vedo dalla mia finestra in mezzo al prato.'; term 'passaggio pedonale' does not match 'cancello pedonale'.
Dove with pianerottolo antecedent and shuttle-stop transfer (9/9 words); the lamp is only offered, so typed 'illumina' competes with 'illuminerà' (EN gloss itself says 'will light up').
Dove sciacquo i piatti plus temporal quando (15/10 words), kitchen vs bathroom coherent; asciutto/riguarda blanks unique; five chips with comma chip legal.
Dove + past event (14/11 words), zip vs low collar and gold buttons; both agreement rows unique; seven distinct terms; recall ritirato.
First con cui at L8 with imperfetto viaggiavo (13/10 words), pencil transfer; mio/iniziali rows unique; initials correct the striped-ribbon mix-up.
A cui matches affidare a (12/11 words); rear workshop and estimate form a real exchange; both infinitive rows unique; German placeholder again says 'Gast'.

In cui at the plate/wood contact (16/12 words, at limits), screw agreed first; gira/vuoto blanks unique; chips allow 'La maniglia balla nel punto della porta del balcone in cui…' as a second grammatical order.

findings.issue: Typed form gap 'deve' is underdetermined: 'ma dovrebbe affacciarsi sul cortile' is an equally valid surface and the cue 'dovere (un terrazzo)' does not restrain tense/mood. Convert to a cue-free choice row; the four options already make only 'deve' possible with subject 'un terrazzo'.

Typed form gap 'illumina' is underdetermined: the lamp has only been offered, so 'la lampada illuminerà almeno i primi gradini' is natural (the EN gloss even says 'will light up') and the cue does not fix the tense. Convert to a cue-free choice row where only 'illumina' agrees with 'la lampada'.

Chips 'Il cortile' / 'che vedo dalla mia finestra' / 'ha un fico' / 'in mezzo al prato.' also build the grammatical, meaningful 'Il cortile ha un fico che vedo dalla mia finestra in mezzo al prato.', which the exact grader rejects. Bind the relative to its antecedent so only the target order is possible.
